text:
Very blurry distorted image! It’s not a painting, just printed on the canvas.. This is a printed canvas. In order to give the “3D image” they have blobbed white paint on a just a few flowers. They didn’t even follow the flower’s design.
The rest of the print on canvas is blurred and the image looks distorted.
